resolution: Source specific-objective bullet, plus two explicitly marked cross-cutting aims; not each nested example. Multiple objective tags share marks, so associated marks must not be summed across objectives. Topic shares use one primary context only.

classes.probed_high: 5 marks or more, or 3 or more distinct series
classes.probed_mid: Observed, maximum 3 or 4 marks and fewer than 3 distinct series
classes.probed_low: 2 marks or fewer and fewer than 3 distinct series
classes.unprobed_2020_2024: No mapped part in the available 2020-2024 corpus; remains compulsory syllabus coverage
